title: Origin story: Vainamoinen
description: Vainamoinen was born of the primal waters before the world was finished, floating for centuries until the earth formed beneath him. The eternal sage of the Kalevala, he sang creation into deeper order, built the first kantele from a pike's jawbone, and sought the Sampo's restoration through song-magic.
